Jordan / Acme security team —

Attached is a compact evidence bundle addressing your SIG questions for encryption and key management. Summary items included below and attached files: redwood-kms-arch-diagram.pdf, rotation-audit-sample.csv, hsm-compatibility-statement.pdf.

Summary (high level):
- Encryption at rest: All persistent customer data stored by Redwood is encrypted using AES-256. For Hosted deployments customers may opt for Redwood-managed keys (RKM) or customer-managed KMS (CMK). CMKs are integrated via cloud provider native KMS APIs (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault).
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ with modern ciphers (ECDHE) is enforced for all ingress/egress; internal service-to-service traffic is mTLS where feasible and encrypted within VPCs.
- Key storage & HSM: Redwood does not persist plaintext keys. For customers requiring HSM-backed keys we support CloudHSM (AWS), Azure Dedicated HSM, and FIPS 140-2 Level 3 certified appliances for Private/on-prem engagements. See hsm-compatibility-statement.pdf for vendor specifics and recommended configurations.
- Rotation policy & sample logs: Our default rotation cadence for Redwood-managed host keys is 90 days; customer-managed keys follow the customer's policy. rotation-audit-sample.csv contains a redacted extract of key rotation events (timestamps, rotation_id, type, rotated_by_role). Sensitive identifiers have been replaced with hashed IDs.
- Access controls & audit: Operational access to key management APIs is restricted to a small set of SRE/infra roles via IAM with break-glass approval flows. All key operations (create/rotate/delete/get) are logged to an immutable audit stream with retention of 1 year for Hosted; Private deployments are configured per customer retention policy.

Attachments: (1) redwood-kms-arch-diagram.pdf — diagram showing Hosted vs Private key flows and where HSM/KMS fit; (2) rotation-audit-sample.csv — redacted rotation events; (3) hsm-compatibility-statement.pdf — vendor support and recommended settings.

If you want an exported SOC-2 control mapping or a signed HSM vendor attestation we can add that — let me know.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
